16L Mineral Water Pot Mineral Filter

The Puritech 16L Mineral Water Pot Mineral Filter provides fresh, clean, and mineral-rich water for your home or office. It removes impurities such as chlorine and sediments while adding essential minerals like calcium and magnesium to improve taste and support your health.

Thanks to its multi-stage filtration system, the filter delivers safe drinking water efficiently. Additionally, its 16L capacity ensures enough water for daily use without frequent refills. The compact design fits neatly on tables or countertops, making it convenient for any space. Regular filter replacement keeps it performing at its best.

Filtration Layers of the 16L Mineral Water Pot Mineral Filter

1st Layer - Granular Activated Carbon

  • Granular activated carbon is widely used in home drinking water filters because of its powerful ability to absorb impurities. In fact, one pound of carbon has a surface area of 125 acres, allowing it to capture thousands of chemicals, dirt, dust, salt, and chlorine. Historically, Egyptians discovered that carbon could purify water, and in our filter, its effectiveness is enhanced by combining it with three other highly efficient elements in a single cartridge.

2nd Layer - Silica Sand

  • Silica sand, composed of silicon and oxygen, acts as a natural purifier. Its porous structure traps unwanted elements while maintaining water at a cool and fresh temperature. Additionally, silica supports healthy bones and connective tissue and is gaining popularity as a mineral supplement that may reduce signs of aging and support cardiovascular and cognitive health.

3rd Layer - Zeolite

  • Zeolite is a natural volcanic material with a unique crystalline structure that allows selective absorption of harmful elements. This layer exchanges sodium ions for calcium, producing soft water, and has a strong affinity for heavy metals such as mercury, lead, and chromium. Moreover, its ion-exchange process ensures that harmful ions are effectively removed from your drinking water.

4th Layer - Mineral Sand / Mineral Stone

  • Mineral stone contains essential minerals such as potassium, sodium, calcium, and magnesium. It naturally enriches water while keeping it fresh and healthy. Throughout history, mineral stones have been used in health products for centuries due to their beneficial properties.

Additional Layer - Ion-Exchange Resin / Bio Ball

  • Ion-exchange resins replace unwanted impurity ions in water with safe ions released from the resin. This process happens rapidly and reversibly, ensuring consistent purification. To maintain effectiveness, the resin must be regenerated periodically, restoring it to its original ionic form.

Key Features:

  • Multi-Stage Filtration: Removes sediments, chlorine, and other impurities for safe water.
  • Mineral Enrichment: Adds calcium and magnesium to improve taste and support health.
  • Easy Installation: Quick and simple to set up at home or in the office.
  • Compact & Practical: 16L capacity fits neatly in kitchens, offices, or shared spaces.
  • Cost-Effective Solution: Provides clean, mineral-rich water every day at an affordable price.

For best results, wash the pot regularly and replace the filter every six months, depending on water quality. This ensures fresh, tasty water and extends the life of your filter. In addition, following this maintenance schedule guarantees everyone enjoys clean, healthy water at all times.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1: How often should I replace the filter?
A1: For optimal performance, replace the filter every six months, depending on your water quality. Regular replacement ensures fresh, clean, and mineral-rich water.

Q2: Can I use this filter with tap water?
A2: Yes! The 16L Mineral Water Pot Mineral Filter is designed for municipal tap water. Its multi-stage system effectively removes impurities while adding essential minerals.

Q3: How much water does the pot hold?
A3: The pot has a 16-liter capacity, providing enough clean, healthy water for your household or office without frequent refills.

Q4: What minerals are added to the water?
A4: The filter enriches water with calcium, magnesium, potassium, and sodium, enhancing both taste and health benefits.

Q5: Is the filter easy to clean and maintain?
A5: Absolutely! The pot is simple to wash, and the cartridge is easy to replace, ensuring long-lasting performance and consistent water quality.

Q6: Does it improve the taste of water?
A6: Yes. The combination of granular activated carbon, silica sand, zeolite, and mineral stones removes chlorine, impurities, and odors while adding beneficial minerals, resulting in fresh and great-tasting water.
